fields.description: We are looking for a Presales Engineer to join our passionate international team. At Graphwise, you’ll work alongside great people with a wide variety of backgrounds and talents who share a passion for knowledge management and AI technologies. If you are interested in AI technology and innovation then Graphwise is the right fit for you! About Graphwise: Graphwise enables organizations to realize the full value of enterprise AI by delivering the most comprehensive and trusted industry solutions in the field of knowledge graphs and semantic AI technologies. Graphwise delivers the critical knowledge graph infrastructure to ensure enterprises are ready to realize the technology’s full potential. Graphwise, which is the result of the merger between tech visionaries Ontotext and the Semantic Web Company, has over 200 employees worldwide and offices located across North America, Europe and APAC. About the Role: As Presales Engineer, you will work with prospective customers and partners to understand their technical and business challenges, design solution architectures using Graphwise technologies, and demonstrate how our platform can deliver measurable value. You will guide customers through the technical evaluation process, from discovery and solution design to proof-of-concepts and implementation planning. Your goal will be to help our partners and customers increase their top-line revenue while ensuring successful adoption of Graphwise technology. You will partner closely with Sales, Partner, Services, and Marketing teams to provide technical expertise throughout the sales process. Your Main Responsibilities shall include: ● Lead the technical engagement during the sales cycle, including discovery, solution design, and technical validation. ● Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, data challenges, and integration requirements. ● Translate customer needs into solution architectures using Graphwise technologies such as knowledge graphs and semantic AI. ● Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, proof-of-value, and proof-of-concept design and planning ● Collaborate with Direct Sales, Partner Sales, Marketing, Product, and Solution teams to develop winning solutions ● Support technical onboarding and deployment planning for new customers and partners. ● Serve as a trusted technical advisor to prospects and customers throughout the sales process. ● Continuously learn and stay current on Graphwise technologies, AI trends, and the evolving data ecosystem. ● Contribute feedback from the field to help improve product capabilities and sales strategies. As the Ideal Candidate, You Will Have: ● Understanding or interest in semantic web technologies, knowledge graphs, graph databases, text mining, ontology engineering, machine learning, or related fields. ● Experience supporting technical sales processes, solution engineering, or at customer-facing technical roles. ● Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for customers. ● Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with the ability to interpret technical and market data. ● Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus. ● Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams. ● And, of course, we offer free tea, coffee, fruit, and snacks What We Offer: ● A friendly and professional international team and working environment in a rapidly-expanding tech and AI company ● Exposure to the newest technologies in AI and knowledge graphs space ● A workplace in an organization that is committed to sustainability and responsible business practices ● An international workspace where more than 65% of colleagues come from across the globe. English is the main working language at the company ● Flexible working hours and benefits that reflect our belief that a healthy work-life balance is a key driver of efficiency ● Career development path, through: paid internal & external trainings on an individual and team level; hands-on experience and many more ● And, of course, we offer free tea, coffee, fruit, and snacks Graphwise welcomes applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, disability, and other statuses. Our company culture as well as policies enforced by our active Diversity Equity & Inclusion Group work towards ensuring we have an inclusive workplace.
